Two batteries share the load, with flight time reaching up to 27 minutes when paired with the X4S camera. Self-heating technology is designed to help the drone operate in cold conditions.

Safety and control are handled by obstacle avoidance that covers two directions, with sensor redundancy built into the flight system. Intelligent flight modes, including Spotlight Pro, let a single pilot plan and fly complex, cinematic moves. The upgraded video link streams from an onboard FPV camera and the main camera at once, over dual frequency and dual channels, helping the pilot and camera operator collaborate.
